system.description:
You infuse chakra into a chakra seal as you attempt to mark a person with the seal of descension and then shatter it causing a fracture in their internal balance of Yin and Yang. A creature you can see within range, must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save the target creature takes 2d8 Force damage and 2d8 Chakra damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and both damage types by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, on a failed save, affected creature gains 1 rank of Sealed. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, on a failed save, an affected creature becomes unable to make Hand Seals (HS) until the beginning of their next turn.
